### Active
- Wire and test net crafting and gacha UI handlers.
- Implement castle unlocking, home progression, and custom-build home gameplay.
- Add styling and verify game syntax/runtime and browser appearance.

- Castle UI/controls and progression are not implemented; `updateUI()` now references `#castle-name`, but that element has not been added to `index.html`, so startup may fail.
- Armory markup has `#craft-net` and `#open-sanctum` controls, but no handlers are wired yet.

## Objective
- Continue Mythwyld — Dragonbound as a playable game, now with a 3D design, many character designs, and full customization.

## Requirements
- Latest request: “3d design with many character designs full customization”.
- Preserve the meadow gameplay and existing capture, building, collection, and home progression where compatible.
- Keep local saves and ensure cosmetic gacha items have no gameplay stats or duplicate rewards.

## Decisions
- Homes are permanent unlocks; the meadow remains the main gameplay area.
- Gacha rewards are cosmetic armor and furnishings purchased with keepsake sigils.
- Dragon capture uses woven nets, followed by berry offerings to build trust.
- The new 3D and customization request supersedes the earlier 2D-only design direction; scope and implementation remain to be established.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing 2D meadow gameplay includes exploration, foraging, building, quests, bestiary, touch controls, and local saves.
- Net crafting and capture, dragon trust progression, gacha collection, and castle progression logic have been added.
- `game.js` passes `node --check`.

### Active
- Rework the game toward 3D, add multiple character designs, and implement full customization.
- Finish and verify castle/home progression; `drawHome()` exists but is not called by `drawWorld()`.
- Add responsive styles for home and collection UI; test mobile layout.
- Verify gameplay and browser appearance, then refresh and inspect `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the project structure and determine a practical 3D approach that preserves the existing playable meadow and progression.
2. Implement multiple selectable character designs and a full customization flow with locally saved selections.
3. Fix and finish home visuals/progression, add responsive home and collection styling, and verify game interactions.
4. Run `node --check game.js`, perform browser checks, and refresh and inspect `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, save data, canvas rendering, capture, gacha, and castle progression.
- `index.html`: Game interface, navigation, world canvas, and modal shell.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and responsive styles; home and collection styling is pending.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Existing screenshot; refresh after implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appear as untracked in `git status`.
- Castle options are Greenstead Hall, Stonewatch Keep, Moonspire Castle, Wildflower Court, and Founders’ Keep.
- Founders’ Keep requires a forge and three resource-cost stages.
- Current implementation is 2D Canvas; no 3D implementation or character customization system has been completed.
